newsitem.title: FRANCE: CHIRAC CALLS FRENCH ELECTION FOR MAY 25, JUNE 1.
newsitem.headline: CHIRAC CALLS FRENCH ELECTION FOR MAY 25, JUNE 1.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac announced on Monday he was dissolving the National Assembly and called an early parliamentary election for May 25 and June 1.

In a televised address, Chirac said he had decided to bring forward the poll by more than nine months so that the French people could "express themselves clearly on the scale and speed of change over the next five years".
